```lean
intro t
have hX := hm
have hX_meas : Measurable (fun ω => X ω) := hX.measurable
have hX_bounded : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ b - a := hb.trans (Set.Icc.bounded_le_sub a b)
have h_exp_integrable : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
  by
    have h_exp_lipschitz : ∀ ω, Real.exp (t * X ω) ≤ Real.exp (t * (b - a)) :=
      by intro ω; apply Real.exp_lipschitz; exact abs_le.2 hX_bounded
    have h_exp_bound : ∀ ω, Real.exp (t * X ω) ≤ Real.exp (t * (b - a)) :=
      h_exp_lipschitz
    have h_exp_nonneg : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Real.exp (t * X ω) := by intro ω; apply Real.exp_nonneg
    have h_exp_integrable_by_bound : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
      by
        refine (MeasureTheory.integrable_le (Real.exp (t * (b - a)) • 1) μ).mpr _
        refine (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _ μ).mpr _
        exact (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure.isFiniteMeasure μ).isFiniteMeasure
        exact (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure.isFiniteMeasure μ).isFiniteMeasure
        exact (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure.isFiniteMeasure μ).isFiniteMeasure
        exact (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure.isFiniteMeasure μ).isFiniteMeasure
    exact h_exp_integrable_by_bound
```
